name: ac-direct-real-estate
description: Analysing direct property as an asset rather than through a fund: net operating income and its stability, lease structure and tenant credit, capitalisation rates and what they assume, valuation methods and the appraisal they rest on, capital expenditure and its deferred component, financing and covenants at the property level, and the written property record. It explains the income and valuation arithmetic; it never recommends a property and never predicts prices. Use when asking "net operating income", "NOI", "cap rate", "lease structure", "triple net", "tenant credit", "property valuation", "appraisal", "deferred maintenance", "property level debt", "direct real estate". Not for real-estate vehicles and funds (ac-alternatives-and-real-assets), not for REIT equity analysis (ac-equity-research), not for mortgage-backed securities (ac-securitisation-and-tranches).
